synopsis.title: Arm D appendix — MRD-12 oral small molecule versus shared control
synopsis.rationale: MRD-12 showed target engagement and an acceptable safety profile in the sponsor phase 1 study (synthetic briefing document); the platform shared control allows a randomized comparison without a separate control arm.

objectives.text: Evaluate the efficacy of MRD-12 versus shared control on the Disease X functional score at week 24.
Evaluate the safety and tolerability of MRD-12 over 24 weeks.
Characterize MRD-12 plasma exposure in the platform population.

endpoints.text: Change from baseline in Disease X functional score at week 24
Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events and serious adverse events

population.description: Platform population as defined in Master Protocol section 5, with the arm-specific criteria below.

inclusion.text: Eligible for the platform per Master Protocol section 5.1
Estimated glomerular filtration rate of at least 45 mL/min/1.73 m2

exclusion.text: Concomitant use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers within 14 days of randomization

sources.quote: The proposed primary endpoint is the change in functional score at 24 weeks.
Safety and tolerability will be assessed over 24 weeks, with treatment-emergent and serious adverse events followed to week 28.
Trough sampling at weeks 4, 12 and 24 will support exposure-response analysis.
The proposed primary endpoint is the change in functional score at 24 weeks.
Safety and tolerability will be assessed over 24 weeks, with treatment-emergent and serious adverse events followed to week 28.
Trough sampling at weeks 4, 12 and 24 will support exposure-response analysis.
Participants must be eligible for the platform as defined in Master Protocol section 5.1.
An estimated glomerular filtration rate of at least 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 is required.
MRD-12 is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate.
A dose-dependent QTc prolongation was observed above 80 mg.
The recommended phase 2 dose is 40 mg once daily.
Placebo tablets matching MRD-12 will be used for blinding against the shared control.

consistency_checks.detail: Arm-specific criteria narrow but do not contradict the platform population; control participants remain eligible for comparison.
Week 4 ECG is not in the Master Protocol schedule; it adds a visit activity at shared visits for this arm only.
